blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This study evaluates the added prognostic value of day-1 multimodal MRI for predicting three-month functional outcome after acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Sixty-six AIS patients with ADC, DWI, FLAIR, and clinical data were analyzed. Three-dimensional pretrained ResNet embeddings were extracted from each MRI modality, reduced using fold-isolated principal component analysis, and combined with structured clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers. Linear support vector machines were evaluated using eight-fold stratified group cross-validation across MRI modality combinations. Clinical-only modeling achieved strong performance (AUC = $0.899 \pm 0.151$), while MRI-only models showed limited discrimination (AUC $\approx$ $0.67$-$0.73$). Among multimodal configurations, FLAIR-clinical fusion achieved the highest mean cross-validated performance (AUC = $0.948 \pm 0.061$), followed by ADC-clinical fusion (AUC = $0.941 \pm 0.094$). Full ADC-DWI-FLAIR fusion did not consistently outperform single-modality clinical fusion. Feature-importance analysis identified age, NIHSS subscores, ADC lesion burden, and learned FLAIR representations as key contributors, while qualitative FLAIR activation maps showed responses over lesion-like regions. These findings suggest that compact day-1 FLAIR and ADC representations provide complementary prognostic information beyond clinical variables and support interpretable, data-efficient outcome prediction in AIS.
blocks.zh: 本研究评价了第1天多模式核磁共振的附加预测值,用于预测急性异化中风(AIS)后三个月的功能结果. 分析了66名ADC、DWI、FLAIR的AIS病人和临床数据。 从每一种核磁共振模式中提取了三维预先训练的ResNet嵌入物,利用折叠同位的主要组件分析并结合了结构化的临床变量和ADC衍生的损伤生物标记而减少。 线性支持矢量机通过跨磁共振模式组合的8倍分级组交叉验证进行了评价. 只有临床模型的性能很强(AUC=0.899\pm 0.151美元),而只有核磁共振模型的性能显示有限歧视(AUC约0.67美元-0.73美元)。 在多模式配置中,FLAIR-临床聚变实现了最高平均跨验证性能(AUC=0.948\pm 0.061美元),其次是ADC-临床聚变(AUC=0.941\pm 0.094美元). 完全ADC-DWI-FLAIR核聚变并非一贯优于单模式临床聚变. 特征-重要性分析确定年龄、NIHSS分计数、ADC损伤负担以及学习的FLAIR表述是关键贡献者,而质量的FLAIR激活图则显示对类似损伤的区域的反应。 这些调查结果表明,紧凑的日-1FLAIR和ADC的表示提供了超出临床变量的补充预测信息,并支持AIS中可解释、数据效率高的结果预测。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Acute ischemic stroke (AIS) remains a major cause of adult disability and long-term functional dependence worldwide [ 7 ] . Early prediction of three-month functional outcome is clinically important because it can support treatment planning, rehabilitation allocation, patient counseling, and trial stratification. The modified Rankin Scale (mRS) is widely used as the standard functional outcome endpoint after stroke, with poor outcome commonly defined as mRS > > 1 or mRS > > 2 depending on the clinical setting [ 1 ] . However, accurate individualized prognosis remains challenging because recovery depends on complex interactions between baseline neurological severity, age, vascular risk factors, lesion burden, treatment response, and early tissue evolution.
blocks.zh: 急性缺血性中风仍然是全世界成人残疾和长期功能依赖的主要原因[7]。 对三个月功能结果的早期预测在临床上很重要,因为它可以支持治疗规划、康复分配、病人咨询和试验分层。 被修改的Rankin Scale(mRS)被广泛用作中风后的标准功能结果终点,不良结果通常被定义为mRS > 1或mRS >. 2取决于临床环境[1]. 然而,准确的个性化预测仍然具有挑战性,因为恢复取决于基线神经严重性、年龄、血管风险因素、损伤负担、治疗反应和早期组织进化之间的复杂相互作用。

blocks.en: Clinical variables such as age, pre-stroke disability, and the National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) are among the strongest predictors of post-stroke outcome [ 15 , 8 ] . Nevertheless, clinical scores alone do not directly capture lesion location, infarct extent, or tissue-level changes after reperfusion. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), especially diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps, provides sensitive markers of acute ischemic injury [ 13 ] . Fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) imaging can provide complementary information related to lesion visibility, edema, and subacute tissue changes. Together, these modalities may improve outcome prediction by representing different aspects of ischemic tissue damage.
blocks.zh: 年龄、中风前残疾等临床变量以及国家健康中风指数研究所(NIHSS)是中风后结果的最强预测者之一。 尽管如此,单靠临床得分并不能直接捕捉出损伤位置,活性程度,或者组织再生后的变化. 磁共振成像(MRI),特别是扩散-加权成像(DWI)和表面扩散系数(ADC)地图,提供了急性异化学损伤的敏感标记[13]. 流体加速反向恢复(FLAIR)成像可以提供与损伤能见度,水肿和亚急性组织变化有关的补充信息. 这些模式合在一起,可以代表异化组织损害的不同方面来改进结果预测。

blocks.en: Recent machine learning and deep learning methods have shown promise for combining imaging and clinical data in stroke prognosis [ 11 , 4 , 10 ] . Three-dimensional convolutional neural networks can extract volumetric representations from MRI without requiring handcrafted radiomic features, while linear classifiers can provide more transparent decision boundaries in small clinical cohorts [ 9 , 2 , 6 ] . However, many studies either focus on a single imaging modality, use imaging as a black-box input, or do not explicitly separate the contribution of clinical variables, MRI modality choice, and lesion-derived biomarkers. This makes it difficult to determine whether performance gains come from deep image representations, structured clinical predictors, or explicit lesion burden measures.
blocks.zh: 最近的机器学习和深层学习方法显示,在中风预后将成像和临床数据相结合[11、4、10]是有希望的。 三维分解神经网络可以在不要求手动放射特征的情况下从核磁共振中提取体积表达,而线性分解器则可以在小型临床组群中提供更透明的决策边界[9,2,6]. 然而,许多研究要么侧重于单一成像模式,将成像作为黑盒输入,要么没有明确区分临床变量、核磁共振模式选择和损害衍生生物标记的作用。 这使得很难确定性能的提高是来自深刻的图像表现,结构化的临床预测器,还是明确的损伤负担测量.

blocks.en: A further challenge is data efficiency. Stroke imaging datasets with complete longitudinal clinical outcomes are often small, making end-to-end deep learning prone to overfitting. Hybrid approaches that use pretrained 3D networks as feature extractors, followed by fold-isolated dimensionality reduction and linear classification, may offer a practical compromise between representation learning and interpretability [ 14 , 3 , 5 ] . In this setting, systematic evaluation of MRI modality combinations is important: adding more modalities does not necessarily improve generalization, especially when sample size is limited and modality-specific features are redundant or noisy. Our previous work showed that day-1 ADC-based multimodal modeling improved three-month mRS prediction compared with baseline ADC imaging, highlighting the prognostic value of early post-treatment diffusion changes [ 12 ] . However, that study focused primarily on ADC and did not systematically evaluate the relative contribution of ADC, DWI, and FLAIR modality combinations or explicitly separate the effect of ADC-derived lesion biomarkers from MRI image inputs.
blocks.zh: 另一个挑战是数据效率。 具有完整纵向临床结果的弦相成像数据集往往很小,使端到端的深度学习容易被过度适应. 采用预加训练的3D网络作为特征提取器,再用折叠同位化维度减小和线性分类的混合方法,可在表现学习和可解释性[14、3、5]之间提供实际妥协。 在这种背景下,系统评价核磁共振模式组合很重要:增加更多模式并不一定能改善通俗化,特别是当样本尺寸有限,模式特定特征冗余或吵闹. 我们先前的研究表明,基于ADC的多式模型比基线ADC成像改进了三个月的mRS预测,突出了早期处理后扩散变化的预测价值[12]。 然而,该研究主要侧重于ADC,没有系统地评价ADC、DWI和FLAIR模式组合的相对贡献,也没有将ADC产生的损伤生物标记的作用与磁共振图像输入明确区分开来。

blocks.en: In this work, we evaluate day-1 multimodal MRI fusion for predicting three-month functional outcome after AIS in a quality-controlled cohort of 66 patients. We compare ADC, DWI, and FLAIR representations individually and in combination, with and without structured clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers. We use pretrained 3D ResNet feature extraction, fold-isolated principal component analysis, and class-balanced linear support vector machines under eight-fold stratified group cross-validation. In addition to predictive performance, we provide interpretability through filtered linear coefficient analysis and qualitative FLAIR CNN activation maps. Our goal is to identify which imaging modalities and lesion-derived features add prognostic value beyond clinical variables, while maintaining a data-efficient and interpretable modeling framework.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们评价了第1天多模式核磁共振聚变,以预测在有质量控制的66名病人群体中进行人工诊断后三个月的功能结果。 我们单独和合并地比较ADC、DWI和FLAIR的表述,与结构化的临床变量和ADC引起的损伤生物标记进行比较。 我们使用预先训练的3D ResNet 特性提取,折叠同位化主元件分析,以及在八倍分层组交叉验证下进行类平衡线性支持矢量机. 除了预测性能,我们通过过滤线性系数分析和质量FLAIR CNN活化图提供可解释性. 我们的目标是确定哪些成像模式和病变特征在临床变量之外增加了预测值,同时维持一个数据高效和可解释的模型框架。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Cohort and Outcome
blocks.zh: 2.1 合作与结果

blocks.en: This retrospective study included 66 patients with acute ischemic stroke (AIS) who had day-1 ADC, DWI, and FLAIR MRI available after quality control, together with structured clinical variables and three-month modified Rankin Scale (mRS) outcome. Clinical variables included demographics, vascular risk factors, pre-stroke disability, and NIHSS subscores at baseline and day 1. The binary endpoint was favorable outcome (mRS ≤ 1 \leq 1 ) versus unfavorable outcome (mRS > 1 >1 ). Patient identifiers were used as grouping variables to prevent leakage across cross-validation folds.
blocks.zh: 这项回顾性研究包括66名急性异性中风病人,他们有日一ADC、DWI和FLAIR核磁共振在质量控制后可用,以及结构化的临床变量和三个月修改的Rankin Class(mRS)结果。 临床变量包括人口统计、血管风险因素、中风前残疾以及基线和日数的NIHSS分分数 1. 联合国 二进制终点是有利的结果(mRS #####@leq 1),而不是不利的结果(mRS > 1 > 1)。 患者识别器被用作分组变量,以防止跨交叉验证折叠渗出.

blocks.en: 2.2 MRI Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.2 核磁共振 预处理

blocks.en: MRI data were loaded from clinical DICOM series and processed in physical space. Candidate image series were identified from DICOM metadata, grouped by SeriesInstanceUID, and the largest valid image series was selected for each patient and modality. Slice ordering was checked using spatial DICOM information when available, and duplicate slice positions were removed. ADC, DWI, and FLAIR volumes were resampled with linear interpolation to a common physical spacing of 1.02 × 1.02 × 5.4 1.02\times 1.02\times 5.4 mm and converted to depth-height-width order. Volumes were center-padded to 32 × 256 × 256 32\times 256\times 256 without cropping anatomy. Patients were excluded if any requested modality failed prespecified physical coverage requirements. Per-volume robust intensity normalization was applied using finite, nonzero valid voxels while excluding padded background.
blocks.zh: 核磁共振数据是从临床DICOM系列中加载并在物理空间中处理的。 从DICOM元数据中确定了候选人图像系列,由SeriesInstanceUID分组,并为每个病人和模式选择了最大的有效图像系列. 在有空间DICOM信息的情况下,利用空间DICOM信息检查了片段订单,并移除了重复的切片位置。 ADC,DWI,和FLAIR等卷被用线性插图重印到一般物理间距为1.02×1.02×5.4 1.02\times 1.02\times 5.4mm并被转换为深度-高-宽顺序. 卷被中加到32×256×256 32\times 256\times 没有收割解剖学。 如果任何要求的方式都未能达到预先规定的物理覆盖要求,病人就被排除在外。 每批量强强度正常化是使用有限度的、非为零的有效花瓶进行的,但不包括加成背景。

blocks.en: 2.3 Lesion Biomarkers and MRI Features
blocks.zh: 2.3 Lesion生物标记和核磁共振特征

blocks.en: Three ADC-derived lesion-burden features were used: lesions defined at ADC thresholds of 480 × 10 − 6 ​ mm 2 / s 480\times 10^{-6}\,\text{mm}^{2}/\text{s} and 620 × 10 − 6 ​ mm 2 / s 620\times 10^{-6}\,\text{mm}^{2}/\text{s} , and a combined weighted lesion measure incorporating both thresholds. Small isolated connected components were removed before feature calculation. MRI representations were extracted from ADC, DWI, and FLAIR using pretrained three-dimensional ResNet branches implemented in MONAI. Modality embeddings were evaluated individually and in all possible combinations to assess the relative contribution of ADC, DWI, FLAIR, and multimodal MRI fusion.
blocks.zh: 使用了三种ADC产生的损伤负担特征:在ADC阈值为480×10-6毫米2 / s 480\tims 10×6×6×;\text{mm×2}/\text{s}和620×10−6毫米2 / s 620\tims 10×6×6;\text{mm×2}/\text{s}的损伤定义,以及包含两个阈值的综合加权损伤计量。 在特性计算之前,小的相隔离连接组件被移除. 磁共振指数来自ADC、DWI和FLAIR,使用了在MONAI实施的三维ResNet分机。 对嵌入模式进行了单独和所有可能组合的评价,以评估ADC、DWI、FLAIR和多模式磁共振的相对贡献。

blocks.en: 2.4 Clinical-Imaging Fusion
blocks.zh: 2.4 临床成像

blocks.en: For each configuration, selected MRI embeddings were concatenated with the corresponding clinical/tabular feature block. We evaluated MRI-only models, clinical-only models, and MRI-clinical fusion models. To isolate the contribution of ADC-derived lesion biomarkers, clinical and MRI-clinical configurations were evaluated with and without these lesion features. The clinical-only model without ADC lesion biomarkers was used as the reference baseline for reporting incremental performance.
blocks.zh: 对于每个配置,选定的核磁共振嵌入物被同相应的临床/表格特征块相配合. 我们评价了只有核磁共振模型,只有临床模型, 和核磁共振-临床聚变模型。 为了分离ADC引起的损伤生物标记的作用,对临床和核磁共振临床结构进行了评估,无论有无这些损伤特征。 没有ADC损伤生物标记的仅临床模型被用作报告增量性能的参考基准。

blocks.en: 2.5 Classification and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.5 分类和评价

blocks.en:
Dimensionality reduction and feature scaling were performed within each training fold and then applied to the held-out validation fold to prevent information leakage. Classification used a class-balanced linear support vector machine. Models were evaluated using eight-fold stratified group cross-validation with patient-level grouping. Performance was reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation across validation folds using AUC, accuracy, and F1-score. Models were ranked by mean cross-validated AUC. Network and classifier settings were fixed across modality comparisons,
and all learned preprocessing was fitted within each training fold. The primary
FLAIR-clinical model with ADC-derived lesion biomarkers was compared with
the clinical-only baseline using an exact two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank
test on validation AUCs from the corresponding cross-validation folds.
blocks.zh:
每个培训套装中都进行了尺寸缩小和特征缩放,然后应用到搁置的验证套装中,以防止信息泄漏。 分类使用类平衡线性支持向量机. 对模型进行了八倍分级分组与病人级别分组的交叉验证。 使用AUC、精确度和F1-分数的校正折叠式平均标准差。 模型按平均交叉认证的AUC排名. 网络和分类器设置在模式比较中固定下来,
所有学习到的预处理都安装在每套训练材料中。 小学
将FLAIR-临床模型与ADC产生的损伤生物标记进行了比较。
使用精确的双面配对 Wilcoxon 签名排名的临床基准
从相应的交叉验证折叠中测试AUC。

blocks.en: Table 1: Cross-validation performance for selected configurations. Values are mean ± \pm standard deviation across folds. Delta AUC is computed relative to the clinical-only model without ADC lesion biomarkers.
blocks.zh: 表1:选定配置的交叉验证性能. 值是平均值 ±\pm 跨折叠的标准偏差 。 Delta AUC是相对于没有ADC损伤生物标记的仅临床模型来计算的.

blocks.en: 2.6 Explainability
blocks.zh: 2.6 可解释性

blocks.en: Global interpretability was assessed using a direct linear probe on FLAIR embeddings, clinical variables, and ADC lesion biomarkers. Rare binary variables were excluded from displayed feature-importance plots to reduce coefficient instability. Feature importance was summarized from average linear coefficients across folds. Local imaging interpretation used qualitative intermediate FLAIR CNN activation maps, shown alone and overlaid on raw FLAIR slices. These maps were used as qualitative activation visualizations, not as lesion segmentation or causal attribution.
blocks.zh: 利用FLAIR嵌入物、临床变量和ADC损伤生物标记的直接线性探测器评估了全球可解释性。 为了减少系数不稳定性,将稀有二进制变量排除在显示的特性-重要性地块之外。 从各种折叠的平均线性系数中总结了特征的重要性。 局部成像判读使用FLAIR CNN活化图质中间体,单独显示并覆盖在原始FLAIR片上. 这些地图被用作定性活化可视化,而不是作为损伤分化或因果归属.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Overall Model Performance
blocks.zh: 3.1 总体模式绩效

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the main cross-validation results. The clinical-only baseline without ADC-derived lesion biomarkers achieved strong performance (AUC = 0.899 ± 0.151 =0.899\pm 0.151 , accuracy = 0.845 ± 0.161 =0.845\pm 0.161 , F1 = 0.820 ± 0.145 =0.820\pm 0.145 ). MRI-only models showed substantially lower discrimination, with mean AUCs ranging from 0.675 0.675 to 0.719 0.719 , indicating that image embeddings alone were insufficient for robust prediction in this cohort.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了主要的交叉验证结果。 没有ADC衍生的损伤生物标记的临床唯一基线取得了强效性能(AUC=0.899±0.151=0.899\pm0.151,准确性=0.845±0.161=0.845\pm0.161,F1=0.820±0.145=0.820\pm0.145). 核磁共振唯一的模型显示,其差别明显较低,平均AUC值从0.675 0.675到0.719 0.719不等,表明仅植入图像不足以对这一组群进行有力的预测.

blocks.en:
The best-performing configuration was FLAIR combined with clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers, achieving AUC = 0.948 ± 0.061 =0.948\pm 0.061 , accuracy = 0.802 ± 0.093 =0.802\pm 0.093 , and F1 = 0.732 ± 0.175 =0.732\pm 0.175 . This represented a numerical AUC improvement of + 0.049 +0.049 over the clinical-only reference. The paired fold-level AUC
difference was significant according to an exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank
test ( p = 0.0078 p=0.0078 ). ADC-clinical fusion with ADC lesion biomarkers also performed strongly (AUC = 0.941 ± 0.094 =0.941\pm 0.094 ), followed by ADC-FLAIR clinical fusion with lesion biomarkers (AUC = 0.932 ± 0.070 =0.932\pm 0.070 ). In contrast, combining all three MRI modalities did not provide the highest performance, suggesting that full modality fusion may introduce redundant or noisy information in a small-sample setting.
blocks.zh:
性能最好的配置是FLAIR与临床变量和ADC衍生的损伤生物标记结合,实现AUC=0.948±0.061=0.948\pm 0.061,精度=0.802±0.093=0.802\pm 0.093,F1=0.732±0.175=0.732\pm 0.175. 这比临床参考数字增加了0.049+0.049。 相配的折叠级AUC
根据精确的双侧Wilcoxon签名排名,差异很大
试验(p = 0.0078 p = 0.0078) . ADC-临床聚变与ADC损伤生物标记也表现很强(AUC = 0.941 ± 0.094 = 0.941/pm 0.094),随后ADC-FLAIR临床聚变与损伤生物标记(AUC = 0.932± 0.070 = 0.932/pm 0.070). 相比之下,结合所有三种核磁共振模式并不能提供最高的性能,这表明全模式聚变可能在小样本环境中引入冗余或吵闹的信息.

blocks.en: 3.2 Contribution of MRI Modalities and ADC Lesion Biomarkers
blocks.zh: 3.2 磁共振模式和ADC Lesion生物标志的贡献

blocks.en: Among single-modality clinical-imaging fusion models, FLAIR and ADC provided the strongest complementary information. FLAIR-clinical fusion with ADC lesion biomarkers achieved the highest AUC, while ADC-clinical fusion achieved the highest F1 among the multimodal models. DWI-clinical fusion was weaker (AUC = 0.893 ± 0.100 =0.893\pm 0.100 with ADC lesion biomarkers), and DWI-FLAIR fusion did not improve performance over the clinical baseline.
blocks.zh: 在单一模式临床成像聚变模型中,FLAIR和ADC提供了最强的补充信息。 FLAIR-临床聚变与ADC损伤生物标志实现最高AUC,而ADC-临床聚变在多模式中实现最高F1. DWI-临床聚变较弱(AUC=0.893±0.100=0.893\pm 0.100与ADC损伤生物标记),而DWI-FLAIR聚变的性能没有超过临床基线.

blocks.en: ADC-derived lesion biomarkers improved several MRI-clinical configurations, particularly FLAIR-clinical fusion, which increased from AUC = 0.889 ± 0.115 =0.889\pm 0.115 without lesion biomarkers to 0.948 ± 0.061 0.948\pm 0.061 with lesion biomarkers. However, lesion biomarkers did not improve the clinical-only model, which decreased from AUC = 0.899 ± 0.151 =0.899\pm 0.151 without lesion biomarkers to 0.890 ± 0.147 0.890\pm 0.147 with lesion biomarkers. This suggests that ADC-derived lesion burden was most useful when combined with learned MRI representations rather than as a standalone addition to clinical variables.
blocks.zh: ADC产生的损伤生物标记改进了几种核磁共振-临床构型,特别是FLAIR-临床聚变,从AUC=0.889±0.115=0.889\pm0.115没有损伤生物标记增加到了0.948±0.0610.948\pm有损伤生物标记. 然而,损伤生物标记没有改进临床专用模型,从AUC=0.899±0.151=0.899\pm0.151没有损伤生物标记降至0.890±0.1470.890\pm0.147有损伤生物标记. 这表明,当结合所学的核磁共振表现,而不是作为临床变量的单独补充,ADC引起的损伤负担最为有用。

blocks.en: 3.3 Explainability
blocks.zh: 3.3 可解释性

blocks.en: Filtered coefficient analysis identified age, NIHSS-related variables, ADC lesion burden, and learned MRI features among the most influential predictors (Fig. 1 ). Positive coefficients indicated association with unfavorable outcome, while negative coefficients indicated association with favorable outcome. After excluding rare binary variables from visualization, the most prominent contributors included age, day-1 NIHSS subscores, ADC lesion burden features, and several learned FLAIR-derived imaging features.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Filtered global feature importance from the direct linear probe.
Bars show average SVM coefficients across folds after excluding rare binary variables from visualization.
Positive coefficients indicate association with unfavorable outcome (mRS > 1 >1 ), while negative coefficients indicate association with favorable outcome.
Age, NIHSS-related variables, ADC lesion burden, and learned MRI features contributed to the prediction.

blocks.en: This study evaluated whether day-1 multimodal MRI adds prognostic information beyond structured clinical variables for predicting three-month functional outcome after AIS. FLAIR combined with clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers achieved the highest cross-validated AUC, whereas the clinical-only model achieved the highest accuracy and F1-score. AUC was used as the primary ranking metric because it evaluates discrimination across decision thresholds, while accuracy and F1 depend on a single operating threshold. Thus, multimodal fusion improved overall patient ranking, although this advantage did not translate into better threshold-dependent classification.
blocks.zh: 这项研究评估了日一多式核磁共振是否在结构化临床变量之外添加了预测性信息,以预测AIS之后三个月的功能结果。 FLAIR与临床变量和ADC衍生的损伤生物标记相结合,实现了最高的交叉验证的AUC,而仅临床模型则实现了最高的精度和F1-分数. AUC被用作首要的排名衡量标准,因为它评价跨越决定阈值的歧视,而精确度和F1则取决于单一的操作阈值. 因此,多式联运组合改善了患者的总体排名,尽管这一优势并没有转化为更好的依赖门槛的分类。

blocks.en: The strong clinical-only performance is consistent with evidence that age, pre-stroke disability, and NIHSS are major predictors of post-stroke recovery [ 15 , 8 ] . MRI-only models performed substantially worse, suggesting that image embeddings alone were insufficient in this small cohort. Nevertheless, FLAIR- and ADC-clinical fusion achieved higher AUCs when combined with clinical information and ADC lesion biomarkers, indicating that day-1 imaging provides complementary tissue-level information in the clinical context.
blocks.zh: 强而有力的临床性能与年龄,中前残疾,和NIHSS是中后恢复的主要预测器[15,8]一致. 仅使用核磁共振的模型表现得更糟糕,说明仅嵌入图像不足以在这个小组中。 尽管如此,FLAIR-和ADC-临床聚变在结合临床信息和ADC损伤生物标记时取得了较高的AUC,表明日一成像在临床背景下提供了补充组织层面的信息.

blocks.en: Full ADC-DWI-FLAIR fusion did not outperform the best single-modality clinical fusion model. This may reflect redundancy between modalities, limited sample size, and the introduction of noisy features, emphasizing the importance of controlled modality-combination experiments.
blocks.zh: 完全ADC-DWI-FLAIR核聚变没有超过最佳的单模式临床核聚变模型. 这可能反映了模式之间的冗余,样本规模有限,以及引入了吵闹的特征,强调控制模式-组合实验的重要性.

blocks.en: Explainability analysis identified age, NIHSS-related variables, ADC lesion burden, and learned MRI features among the most influential predictors. The selected FLAIR channel responded spatially to visible hyperintense abnormalities in the illustrated cases. These visualizations remain exploratory and should not be interpreted as lesion segmentation or causal attribution.
blocks.zh: 可解释性分析查明了年龄、与NIHSS有关的变量、ADC损害负担以及最有影响力的预测者中所学得的核磁共振特征。 选定的FLAIR频道在空间上响应了图例中可见的超强烈异常. 这些可视化仍然是探索性的,不应被解释为损伤分化或因果关系。

blocks.en: This study is limited by its small dataset size and potential scanner and acquisition heterogeneity. External validation is therefore required. Future work will evaluate skull-stripped retraining and larger multicenter cohorts.
blocks.zh: 这一研究受到其小数据集大小以及潜在的扫描仪和获取异质性的限制. 因此需要外部验证。 未来工作将评估颅骨再培训和更大的多中心组群。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Day-1 multimodal MRI fusion improved score-based discrimination for three-month functional outcome prediction after AIS, with FLAIR combined with clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers achieving the highest cross-validated AUC. However, clinical-only modeling remained strongest for threshold-dependent metrics, emphasizing the central role of structured clinical assessment. These findings suggest that FLAIR representations and ADC lesion biomarkers provide complementary prognostic information beyond clinical variables, but require external validation and prospective evaluation before clinical translation.
blocks.zh: 第1天多模式核磁共振聚变改进了基于分数的差别,在AIS之后三个月的功能结果预测中,FLAIR与临床变量和ADC衍生的损伤生物标记相结合,实现了最高的交叉验证的AUC. 然而,仅用于临床的模型对于依赖阈值的测量标准来说仍然是最强的,强调结构化临床评估的中心作用. 这些研究结果表明,FLAIR表示和ADC损伤生物标记提供了超出临床变量的补充预测信息,但需要在临床翻译前进行外部验证和预期评价.

blocks.en: Compliance with Ethical Standards
blocks.zh: 遵守道德标准的情况

blocks.en:
This retrospective study used anonymized clinical data acquired as part of routine care. According to the institutional guidelines of the University of Geneva and the University Hospital of Geneva, the study is covered under existing retrospective data-use approvals, and no additional protocol-specific ethics approval was required.
The study was conducted in accordance with the principles of the Declaration of Helsinki.
blocks.zh:
这项回顾性研究使用了作为常规护理的一部分而获得的匿名临床数据。 根据日内瓦大学和日内瓦大学医院的机构准则,这项研究属于现有追溯性数据使用核准范围,不需要针对具体议定书的道德操守核准。
这项研究是根据《赫尔辛基宣言》的原则进行的。
